title: 第13章 至尊密谈猎杀晚年人皇第14章 无始他妈新成员入群
slug: 遮天刚成天帝聊天群什么鬼
content_zh:
“轰——”
恐怖的极道威压席卷天下。
无上的混沌大道交感天地，演化出一道道异象，青龙、白虎四象随侍左右，天花乱坠，地涌金莲，万千法则形成秩序神链垂落……
林昭带着火麟儿二人降临轮回海。
这一刻。
天下世人全都震撼了。
“人皇居然进入了轮回海！”
“他要巡视所有生命禁区吗？”
“天呐！”
“不愧是人皇！”
宇宙万灵议论纷纷。
他们亲眼目睹人皇毫发无伤的从不死山中走出，然后又进入了轮回海，这种视禁区如后花园的态度，着实让不少人震撼不已……
聊天群内。
姜恒宇、叶凡已经目瞪口呆。
他们在直播间的投影下亲身体会到了太古皇者的威势，那种强大与霸道的气势冠绝天上地下。
无人能够比肩。
【人欲道祖师爷：这就是真正的太古皇者吗？真是令人向往……】
【叶黑：真想成为人皇这样的存在啊！】
这一刻。
姜恒宇、叶凡他们的心中不自觉的生出了一颗名为‘向往’的心，他们也想成为比肩人皇一样的存在，也不知道今后能否实现……

轮回海。
这是一座非常神秘的禁区。
执掌者乃是太古早期证道的轮回之主。
林昭屹立天穹。
他俯视着眼前的这一片轮回海。
辽阔的海域中有着无穷无尽的阴魂汇聚，冥冥之中有着数道强大的神念覆盖了天上地下。
轮回海内一共有四名至尊。
他们冷漠的看着眼前的林昭，并没有开口说话，反而任其巡视天上地下，毕竟他们曾经也是这么过来的。
年轻的成道者：
天上地下！有我无敌！
晚年的成道者：
禁区的哥们还有位置吗？给我腾个位呗……
今日。
他们任由人皇嚣张。
但等到人皇晚年过后就不一样了。
林昭在轮回海内巡视了一圈，他的目光贯穿了层层阻拦，最终停留在一名自封于仙源中的人族古皇身上。
“昀亘？”
“或者叫他逍遥天尊？”
林昭的目光微微闪烁。
逍遥天尊作为曾经的九大天尊之一。

他的实力绝对毋庸置疑，甚至快要比肩真正的天帝级了，原著中以晚年的状态打出时间长河，几乎将圣体大成的叶凡给打死……
content_en:
"Boom——"
The terrifying pressure of the extreme power swept across the world.
The supreme avenue of chaos interacts with the heaven and the earth, evolving a series of strange phenomena. Four elephants, green dragons and white tigers, accompany them around. Flowers fall from the sky, golden lotuses surge from the ground, and thousands of laws form the divine chain of order...
Lin Zhao and Huo Lin'er came to the Sea of Reincarnation.
This moment.
Everyone in the world was shocked.
"The Human Emperor actually entered the Sea of Reincarnation!"
"Is he going to patrol all forbidden areas of life?"
"Oh my God!"
"As expected of the Human Emperor!"
All the beings in the universe were talking about it.
They witnessed with their own eyes the Human Emperor walking out of the Mountain of Immortality without any injuries, and then entering the Sea of Reincarnation. This attitude of treating the restricted area as a back garden really shocked many people...
In the chat group.
Jiang Hengyu and Ye Fan were stunned.
They personally experienced the power of the Ancient Emperor under the projection in the live broadcast room. His powerful and domineering aura was unparalleled in the world.
No one can compare.
[Master of Human Desire Dao: Is this the real ancient emperor? It’s really desirable...]
[Ye Hei: I really want to become a human emperor! 】
This moment.
Jiang Hengyu and Ye Fan unconsciously had a heart called "longing" in their hearts. They also wanted to become a being comparable to the Human Emperor, but they didn't know whether they could achieve it in the future...
The sea of samsara.
This is a very mysterious forbidden area.
The person in charge is the Lord of Reincarnation who attained enlightenment in the early ancient times.
Lin Zhao stands tall in the sky.
He looked down at the sea of ​​samsara in front of him.
There are endless gatherings of ghosts in the vast sea area, and there are several powerful divine thoughts covering the sky and the earth.
There are four supreme beings in the world of reincarnation.
They looked at Lin Zhao indifferently and did not speak. Instead, they allowed him to patrol the sky and the earth. After all, they had been here before.
Young Enlightened One:
Heaven and earth! I am invincible!
Enlightened people in later years:
Do the guys in the penalty area still have room? Make room for me...
Today.
They allowed the Emperor to become arrogant.
But it will be different after the Emperor reaches his later years.
Lin Zhao patrolled around the Sea of ​​Reincarnation. His gaze penetrated all the obstacles and finally landed on a self-proclaimed ancient emperor of the human race in the Immortal Source.
"Yun Gen?"
"Or call him Xiaoyao Tianzun?"
Lin Zhao's eyes flickered slightly.
Xiaoyao Tianzun is one of the nine former Tianzuns.
There is absolutely no doubt about his strength, and he is even close to rivaling the real Heavenly Emperor. In the original work, he fights through time in his later years, almost beating Ye Fan to death...
